1. Broken lower arm
2. Major suspension issue
3. Overheating, broken thermistor/thermostat and coolant boiling plus evaporation on Mumbai Pune expressway.
4. And now: AC compressor broke down and am getting it replaced.
5. In the process, major radiator leakage diagnosed. Having to replace that too.

Oh, not to forget, they claimed the tyres had 40% life left, but had to get all 4 tyres replaced one after another, within a span of 6 months of purchase.

The time this car has spent in the garage and the money and energy we are spending to repair it is equivalent to getting a new car from the factory!

Do not fall for their same day delivery and discounts and free petrol. It's all a tactic they use to make sales, meet target and get rid of trashy cars.
